description: Import a YouTube video into ClipAI and start AI clip detection. Returns a video_id and job_id. Detection runs asynchronously; poll list_clips(video_id) until clips appear (usually under a few minutes), or until list_videos shows that video as ERROR (then no clips will come). Uses one video of the org's monthly quota.

goal.description: Optional steering for what kind of clips to favor.

max_clips.description: Optional cap on how many clips to detect (1-60).

name: import_youtube
